decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model line tied to the firm's announced innovation direction and built close to its core safety-footwear business, management is likely to continue backing it and interpret any weak traction as temporary rather than exit now.

Because this electrostatic-dissipative shoe fits the established occupational-footwear range and uses the firm's existing development and market channels, management would be inclined to retain it despite uncertainty rather than admit an unsuccessful launch.

This multi-model safety-shoe series is close to the firm's core offer and broad-range strategy, so prior development investment and portfolio logic make continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.
